headline_outcome: A Fair Go for Small Business
primary_text: "Every time we bid on something a developer swoops in and outbids us by 200k." What if you could buy a warehouse where developers aren't even in the room? These off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are reserved for owner-occupiers. No investors driving up the price. No auction day heartbreak. Just a straightforward fixed-price purchase for business owners who need space to operate. Located near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Isn't it time small business got a fair go in the property market?
description: Developer-free purchasing — warehouses reserved exclusively for owner-occupiers
